paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption_used: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training sets, displayed as two vertically stacked line plots. In the Easy Training Set (top panel), both Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red) start near 0.0 and increase over 500 steps, with LUFFY reaching approximately 0.4 and On-Policy reaching approximately 0.35 at step 500. In the Hard Training Set (bottom panel), Llama-LUFFY-Hard shows steady improvement from near 0.0 to approximately 0.2 by step 500, while Llama-On-Policy-Hard initially rises to approximately 0.05 before declining back toward 0.0 after step 150. Notably, the performance gap between the two methods is substantially wider on the Easy set, where LUFFY maintains a consistent lead of approximately 0.10 throughout training, compared to the Hard set where their trajectories only clearly diverge after step 200.
model_annotation: The figure presents two vertically stacked line plots illustrating the training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on Easy and Hard training sets over 500 steps. Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Steps," which ranges from 0 to 500 with linear spacing and tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis in both plots is labeled "Training Rewards," scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top panel and from 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom panel, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. In the top panel, titled "Easy Training Set," the teal line representing Llama-On-Policy-Easy starts at approximately 0.0 and rises steadily, reaching about 0.35 by step 500, while the red line for Llama-LUFFY-Easy begins at 0.0 and increases more sharply, reaching approximately 0.4 by step 500; both lines are accompanied by shaded confidence intervals. In the bottom panel, titled "Hard Training Set," the teal line for Llama-On-Policy-Hard rises to approximately 0.05 by step 100 before declining to near 0.0 after step 150 and remaining flat, whereas the red line for Llama-LUFFY-Hard increases gradually from 0.0 to approximately 0.2 by step 500, also with shaded confidence intervals.
